Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches_modified.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches_modified.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches_modified.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. A third, Special contacts, adds Track this user to a person's profile menu and keeps a history of their status and profile changes on this phone. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, Clean links when you copy or paste, does the same for a link you copy or paste into the message box. A third, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. All start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Test server sign-in
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches_added.description: Groundwork for forwarding new messages from one chat to another by rules you set. It doesn't forward anything yet, it only counts the new messages a rule would look at. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches_added.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Bypass integrity check
patches_added.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Suppress screenshot notification
patches_added.description: Stops Telegram from telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Unlock Premium features
patches_added.description: Makes Telegram on your phone treat your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks behind Premium open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits, like upload size, stay the same. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Bot token sign-in
patches_modified.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode and Power off accounts also live, both off by default.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. A third, Special contacts, adds Track this user to a person's profile menu and keeps a history of their status and profile changes on this phone. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, Clean links when you copy or paste, does the same for a link you copy or paste into the message box. A third, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. All start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Test server sign-in
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Log player URLs (debug)
patches_added.description: Research aid, off by default: writes every URL the media player and the LuraPlayer SDK open to the device's local logcat (tag VIXURL). Nothing is sent anywhere.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA; turn it off if you don't use an HTTPS-filtering proxy.

patches_modified.name: Skip ads
patches_modified.description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by emptying the LuraPlayer ad-break schedule — both the client-side VMAP breaks (third-party ads) and the first-party house / cross-promo breaks — so no ad-periods are inserted into the timeline, by removing the ad periods the server stitches into on-demand stream manifests, and by preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.

patches_added.name: Source-independent AutoMix

patches_removed.name: Automix Editor

patches_removed.name: Karaoke

patches_modified.name: Battery saver

patches_modified.name: DJ mode

patches_modified.name: Headphone correction

patches_modified.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches_modified.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

patches_modified.name: JamesDSP

patches_modified.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth

patches_modified.name: Loudness level

patches_modified.name: Mixed-source playlists

patches_modified.name: Per-download quality

patches_modified.name: Pitch control
patches_modified.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Play alongside other apps

patches_modified.name: Sign in with MicroG

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer fade-out

patches_modified.name: Smart downloads

patches_modified.name: Steady playback

patches_modified.name: Streamseek previews
